PluginEntry.Name: Docker Orphan Cleaner
PluginEntry.Author: bitcryptic-gw
PluginEntry.Overview: Lists Docker images that no container references (orphan images) and lets you remove them in bulk instead of one at a time. Each orphan is classified by how safe it is to remove: pinned (never), referenced by a leftover Unraid template, referenced by a Docker Compose stack, tagged but unreferenced, or untagged. Only untagged images are selected by default, deletion is always confirmed, and nothing is ever force-removed. A dry-run mode shows exactly what would be deleted, child images are reported instead of failing a batch, and the reclaimable build cache can be viewed and pruned on request.
